headline: 3 Consumer Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar
summary: Consumer discretionary businesses are levered to the highs and lows of economic cycles. This sensitive demand profile can lead to some stock price volatility, but over the past six months, the industry has stayed on track as its 3.7% return was close to the S&P 500’s.
